messages.subject: We need your help...
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am glad to report that the the number of aroma.affymetrix users and
the number of installations have grown rapidly over the last few
months, and that this steady growth seems to continue. Likewise what
happen to other open-source applications when the number of users
increases, more feedback and suggestions are given and more bugs are
found, which over time leads to a higher-quality product. What also
happens is that more and more questions are asked through the mailing
list. We (mainly Elizabeth, Mark and Henrik) try our best to answer
these questions promptly. However, in order to be able to keep up
with this, I would like you to consider the following:

1) Short and precise questions are more likely to be replied to
promptly, simply because they are easier to answer.

2) Have one main question per message. Avoid putting unrelated
questions in the same message.

3) If you provide as much information as possible about your problem
(e.g. the type of data set, chip type, R script, error message,
sessionInfo() and traceback()), it is easier to locate the problem and
we don't have to spend time asking for such information. Please put
yourself in the position of the person going to help you.

4) If you see a question that you know the answer to, please feel free
to respond to it. If you're not 100% sure you get it correct, we can
always pitch in afterward.

These guidelines will save us all (including you) a lot of time and
hopefully we can all focus our resources on what we all like - the
research. Please note that the development of aroma.affymetrix is
mostly done as a "side" project to our PhD and postdoc projects.

Thanks a lot

Henrik
